preservation: No inherited files, reports, failed runs, results, or checkpoints are deleted. R7 is a new plaintext manuscript, not reconstruction of the incomplete R5 capsule.

continuum.model: Original stopped NDU dynamics, action box, utility, and liquidation contract
continuum.deployment: Feasible bilinear interpolation of each frozen R5 nodal policy, held fixed between decision dates
continuum.verification: One-sided continuous-generator upper and policy-lower witnesses with outward interval arithmetic; no assumption of continuity of the optimal value at an irregular boundary
continuum.units: Absolute normalized lifetime utility; numerical precision, not empirical welfare calibration
continuum.failed_precision: Report the computed bound even when above target

learned_geometry.model: Original NDU state/control/covariance/first-exit geometry with explicitly modified running payoff and a known smooth verification witness
learned_geometry.training: Continuous actor maximizes the witness Hamiltonian; no optimal-action labels
learned_geometry.scope: Learned-actor certificate transfer test, not original-payoff economic evidence

external.method: Unmodified SOCMartNet.train; documented model/network adapter and end-of-update budget scheduler
external.architecture: Two hidden tanh layers of width 48; bounded actor and terminal-exact value, shared across methods
external.model: dX=2a dt+sqrt(2)*0.4 dW, a in [-1,1]^d; cost mean(a^2)+0.3*sin(sum(a))+0.1*mean(sin(a)^2); terminal mean((X-0.5)^2)+0.2*cos(sum(X)/sqrt(d))
external.audit: 4096 paired paths, nested 64/128 time meshes, independent seed 12000+training_seed
external.primary_estimand: NBO minus SOC-MartNet realized cost at 128 steps; six-seed paired t interval, path and mesh uncertainty reported separately
external.claim_boundary: Neither an optimality certificate nor reproduction of the authors' published hardware/architecture budget. Constant diffusion is used because the pinned author interface rejects Hessian-dependent Hamiltonians.

safeguard.scope: Post-review deterministic re-audit of retained R5 policies
safeguard.report: Raw/threshold-safeguarded outcomes, override fractions, full action counts, evaluation and audit timing; do not infer improved raw training from corrected policies

evidence_policy: Retain all outcomes. Software validation, mathematical correctness, numerical precision and empirical superiority are separate findings. No finding is marked closed merely because a script passes.
